whatChanged: NEW: Iberdrola agrees to buy 80% of Finland's Caruna Group for EUR2bn ($2.3bn), extending its regulated power-networks push into the Nordics (ibe-caruna-acquisition)
NEW: Var Energi agrees to acquire BlueNord for ~$1.33bn, creating Europe's largest independent oil and gas producer (var-bluenord-merger)
NEW: OCS Group agrees GBP3.1bn ($4.17bn) all-cash takeover of UK's Mitie Group, delisting it from the LSE (ocs-mitie-acquisition)
NEW: Dassault Systemes signs definitive agreement to acquire ArisGlobal for ~$2.0bn, expanding into life-sciences AI (dsy-arisglobal-acquisition)
NEW: Ford and Geely Auto form EV joint venture at Ford's underused Valencia, Spain plant (f-geely-spain-jv)

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's take-private is still a two-bidder contest between Castlelake (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and Apollo (ezj-apollo-takeover), ITV sold its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale), Prologis's 'best and final' bid for Segro has the board minded to recommend with the PUSU deadline extended to Aug 12 (pld-sgro-takeover-bid), and now OCS Group's agreed GBP3.1bn takeover of Mitie will remove another UK name from the LSE entirely (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE- and shareholder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: EasyJet's take-private is a live Castlelake vs Apollo bidding war (ezj-castlelake-takeover, ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners is bidding $16.75/share for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR are circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital have approached Criteo (crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder took the company private (perf-projectny-going-private), EQT keeps sweetening its Perpetual bid -- now A$22.07/share (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid), Frasers Group's shareholder-led tender for Hugo Boss runs to July 27 at a final EUR38/share (boss-frasers-takeover-offer), Stripe and Advent's joint $53bn+ offer for PayPal remains live after board rejection (pypl-stripe-advent-takeover-bid), and OCS Group's CD&R-backed takeover of Mitie adds a new PE-driven UK delisting (ocs-mitie-acquisition).

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Defense primes keep building out undersea-warfare capability: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition), Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition), and Fincantieri bundling four acquisitions into an underwater-tech champion (fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions).

themes.label: AI data-center capacity and power build-out
themes.note: Capital and commercial partnerships keep pouring into the physical layer of AI compute: TeraWulf's 20-year, ~$19bn AI data-center lease with Anthropic (wulf-anthropic-lease), Meta's expansion of its Louisiana campus to 5GW and $50bn+ (meta-richland-parish-capex), Williams's $5.34bn Blackstone-led JV to fund five behind-the-meter data-center power projects (wmb-blackstone-power-jv), 3M and Microsoft's partnership to deploy 3M's optical technology across Azure's AI data centers (mmm-msft-ai-datacenter-partnership), Microsoft's commitment to deploy AMD's Helios AI systems at scale on Azure (msft-amd-helios-partnership), and AMD's up-to-$5bn equity bet on Anthropic tied to a 2GW MI450 chip deployment (amd-anthropic-chip-partnership).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the already-signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger remains paused by a federal judge's TRO after suits from a 12-state AG coalition and the Writers Guild of America, with a preliminary-injunction hearing set for Aug 3 (psky-wbd-acquisition), while InMode's Special Committee remains procedurally frozen pending the Israeli court's ruling on competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
